attributes.action: if you get it, get it sorted. Cut fuel duty and VAT on road fuel now.
attributes.additional_details:
UK drivers pay fuel duty of 52.95p per litre on petrol and diesel, plus VAT at 20% and VAT is charged on the duty as well as the fuel. On a typical £1.45 litre, more than 75p goes to the Treasury, not the forecourt.
These rates are among the highest in Europe. Germany, Spain and Ireland all charge far less duty on diesel than the UK.
High fuel tax pushes up the cost of commuting, food transport and every service that depends on vehicles. If you get it, sort it.
attributes.background: We want the Government to cut fuel duty and reduce VAT on petrol and diesel. Duty is 52.95p a litre and VAT is 20% charged on the fuel and on the duty itself, so over half of what drivers pay goes to the Treasury, not to fuel

rejection.details:
We are not clear to what extent - or two what exact level - you want these reduced.

We already have many petitions open on the subject of the level of fuel duty and VAT on fuel, including one on removing VAT on fuel duty entirely:

Stop charging VAT on fuel duty
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/782666

And one on removing them both entirely:

Remove fuel duty and VAT on road fuel
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784059
